verdict.rationale: stagewise documents signing in with a stagewise Account to use its managed inference, with plan tiers such as Hobby Free. Its GitHub README also says existing provider subscriptions can be connected, but through an API key rather than a subscription sign-in. One community report describes a sign-in email that never arrived, which adds friction but is a single onboarding report rather than a documented failure of the capability. Missing for 10: documented sign-in (e.g. OAuth) using an existing third-party subscription plan, details on how plan tiers map to agent usage limits, and independent hands-on confirmation that sign-in works reliably.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: stagewise Account — The fastest way to start. Access a large library of pre-configured models through the managed inference service. No API keys needed.
Connect any of the following subscriptions with a single API key to unlock all models the provider offers directly inside stagewise.
Hobby Free — Limited access to 3 standard models (Default, Quick, Smart)
